original_test_intent: Set one approved SDR repository timestamp, verify exact readback and chronology effect, then restore the captured clock/synchronization state.
original_method: Master TBD; Review proposes target-approved Storage 0x0A/0x29 with 0x28 readback.
manual_activity: Owner approves timestamp/timebase, competing sync control, chronology impact and restoration.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly refuses the TBD write; V2's standard mapping is usable only as conditional Review guidance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After confirmation use protected 0x0A/0x29 once, verify with 0x28 and restore the original value/sync policy.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Baseline repository clock/sync, set one approved value, prove bounded readback and no record mutation, then restore.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds conditional write/readback/recovery without changing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Setting SEL time or host time is not repository-time coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Wrong timebase or competing sync can create apparent metadata chronology drift.

project_override_considerations: A vendor API is equivalent only if it changes the same repository clock and preserves exact timebase/readback/restore evidence.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master setter body/Criteria are TBD and boilerplate clears evidence; standard mapping remains conditional Review guidance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operation and recovery shape are identifiable; timestamp/sync/approval are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Makes the chronology-changing write explicit, reversible and separate from SEL/host time.
independent_technical_reasoning: Repository-time acceptance depends on its own epoch and competing writer, not merely a successful four-byte write. Exact 0x28 readback, bracketed reference comparison and proof that SDR records were unchanged are needed before restoring baseline.
